data.gender_notes: Manmohan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Manmohan is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Manas' (mind) and 'Mohan' (enchanter). The name signifies that the person is someone who can influence minds and thoughts with their charm and charisma. In Hindu mythology, Manmohan is also a name for Lord Shiva, who is known to have the power to enchant and influence the minds of devotees and gods alike.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the power of enchantment and influence over the mind.
data.etymology: Manmohan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Manas (mind) Mohan (enchanter).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manmohan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Manmohan Singh served as the Prime Minister of India from 2004 to 2014. The name Manmohan carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Manmohan Singh was appointed as the Prime Minister after the Indian National Congress party won a majority in the Indian Parliament in the 2004 general elections. He is the first Sikh to hold the office of the Prime Minister of India.

historical_references.reference: Manmohan Singh was born on September 26, 1919, in the village of Sabah in present-day Pakistan. He initially studied in Lahore and later moved to Shimla in India.
historical_references.context: Manmohan Singh was born during the British Raj in India. He received his early education in Lahore, which was part of Pakistan at the time. Later, he moved to Shimla, which was in India. Manmohan Singh went on to study economics at the University of Cambridge and later served as the Finance Minister of India from 1991 to 1996.

modern_usage.modern_context: Manmohan Singh, a prominent figure in Indian politics, served as the Prime Minister of India from 2004 to 2014. He is also known for his tenure as the Chairman of the World Bank from 1993 to 1995. In the business world, Manmohan Malhotra is the CEO of Microsoft India. The name 'Manmohan' is derived from Sanskrit and means 'man of the mind' or 'man of thought'.
